jobs.title: Audit desktop main workbench UI
jobs.prompt:
Read AGENTS.md, frontend-design/FRONTEND_SPEC.md, and current desktop renderer code under FocusLink/src/app, src/features/focus, history, tasks, settings, ui, and src/styles. Produce a concrete v0.12.86 desktop UI upgrade proposal for a quiet, utilitarian productivity workbench at default, 980x660, and 1280x720. Preserve product behavior, status wording, timer semantics, and no nested-card rule. Identify exact components/CSS selectors to change, hierarchy/density/contrast problems, long-text and all interaction states, and screenshot acceptance. Do not edit. Do not inspect release EXEs. End with VERDICT / CHANGES / TESTS / RISKS / ARTIFACTS <=2000 chars.

Global job 1/5 (batch 1/1, local 1/5).

jobs.title: Audit two-state mini window UI

Propose a pixel-disciplined visual upgrade that keeps exactly collapsed 184x44 and expanded 256x70, no third size/free resize, all controls and drag/snap behavior. Focus on scan order, typography, progress track, task truncation, pause/running distinctions, hit targets, reduced motion, and DPI/edge placement. Give exact files/selectors and tests. Do not edit. End with VERDICT / CHANGES / TESTS / RISKS / ARTIFACTS <=2000 chars.

Global job 2/5 (batch 1/1, local 2/5).

jobs.title: Audit cross-device design system and QA
jobs.prompt:
Read AGENTS.md, frontend specs, temporal-foundation.css, current desktop/mobile CSS, Icon system, screenshot/smoke/a11y tests, and version/release rules. Define one restrained FocusLink visual direction for v0.12.86 across Windows desktop, mini, Xiaomi phone and Huawei tablet. Audit token consistency, palette balance, typography, spacing, icons/tooltips, focus-visible, contrast, disabled/loading/empty/error states, no nested cards, and responsive stability. Produce a minimal shared-token/change map and exact automated + screenshot + device acceptance matrix. OPPO is frozen/out of-scope. Do not edit. End with VERDICT / CHANGES / TESTS / RISKS / ARTIFACTS <=2000 chars.
